author: GoPro
description:
There's a reason we keep coming back to Vail, Colorado. For over a decade, the GoPro Mountain Games has turned this iconic mountain town into the ultimate playground for the world's best adventure athletes, and 2026 was no exception.

The action spoke for itself — slackliners defying gravity, mountain bikers pushing the limits on every descent, climbers attacking the rock face, runners earning every finish line, and our favorite dog competitors stealing the show as only they can. Add in the art, the music, and the electric energy of Vail Valley, and you've got something that's more than a competition, it's a community.

Shot on the all new GoPro MISSION 1 PRO

Drone flying by: @WillStrathmann
